context: Force-directed network showing skill co-occurrence across 105 D3 blocks: 26 nodes sized by frequency, 59 edges weighted by co-occurrence count, 7 categorical color groups on a dark background with hover-to-highlight interaction
first_impression: The central cluster reads clearly — 7 perceptually distinct colors, glow-rimmed nodes, and low edge opacity prevent the layout from becoming a hairball — but several nodes have drifted far from the main body with no visible connecting edges, making them look purposeless.
what_works: The 7-color palette is bold and distinct on the dark background, making group membership legible at a glance without needing to consult the legend; hover-based dim-to-background interaction elegantly isolates ego networks without cluttering the base view.
what_doesnt: Three nodes (navigation, cartography, data-gathering equivalents — the isolated cyan, grey, and orange outliers) have floated away from the main cluster with edges that are either invisible at low opacity or absent, severing their apparent connection to the whole; in the dense central core, labels for motion, linked-views, canvas, and time-series overlap significantly, making those nodes hard to identify without hovering.
